title: Windows Server 2025 gets support for quick machine recovery
description: Microsoft announced that Windows Server 2025 now supports quick machine recovery following the installation of the October 2026 security update. This update introduces a new feature aimed at improving recovery times for machines running this server version.
aiSummary: The announcement details that IT administrators can leverage a new quick machine recovery feature on Windows Server 2025 after applying the October 2026 security update. No specific vulnerability or exploit details are provided, and the update appears to be a feature enhancement rather than a security threat.
aiImpact: There is no indication of a security vulnerability or exploit associated with this update. The impact is related to operational improvements in recovery processes rather than security risks.
